jobs.occupation: Talent Pool for Campus Internships 2027 – Finance (location: Terneuzen, Netherlands)
jobs.description:
About this talent pool
Looking for an internship starting between January and October 2027, but not seeing any open positions on our website? We then encourage you to sign up for this Dow talent pool. 
Important - This is NOT an individual job opening. If your profile matches a future internship position, our recruiting team will contact you directly.
 

About youWe are looking for 
bachelor’s and
 master’s students (m/f) to support our Finance organization in Terneuzen, the Netherlands.
 

Our Finance organization provides services for several European countries providing you with an international work experience. The department consists of several sub-departments such as Cost Accounting, Treasury, Financial & Statutory, Tax, Credit, Invoice to Cash, and Internal Audit. You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience and work on projects that align with your interests and career goals.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Work on process improvement initiatives. 

• Preparation and review of financial statements. 

• Data analyzing and financial reporting. 

• Review of the VAT and/or Intrastat returns. 

• Implement automation solutions into current processes. 

• Preparing Balance sheet account reconciliations. 

• Connect with other Dow departments like Logistics, Procure to Pay, Customs and HR. 

• Explore tools like SAP, Office (co-pilot), SharePoint, Power Automate. 

Qualifications
 
 

• You are currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in (corporate) finance, accounting, economics, business administration, international business or related field. 

• You have a good working knowledge of English. 

• You are looking to do an internship for 5 to 6 months starting between January and October 2027 (exact timing to be discussed). 

• You can legally work in the Netherlands due to EU-citizenship or already obtained student visa for the Netherlands.
